description: This file defines the Number class within the SCSSPHP project, representing a dimension with associated units, providing methods for unit management, arithmetic operations, comparisons, and serialization. It is a core component handling numeric values with units in SCSS compilation.

classes.name: Number
classes.description: Represents a numeric value with associated units, provides methods for unit conversion, comparison, arithmetic operations, and serialization, supporting complex unit handling for SCSS values.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Number instance with a dimension and associated numerator and denominator units.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the Number instance into a JSON-compatible format, outputting its string representation.

methods.name: offsetExists
methods.description: Checks if a particular offset (like source line, column, index, or type) exists in the object.

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Retrieves the value at a specified offset, such as source line, column, index, or numeric value.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Throws exception because Number instances are immutable.

methods.name: offsetUnset
methods.description: Throws exception because Number instances are immutable.

methods.name: unitless
methods.description: Checks if the number has no units.

methods.name: hasUnits
methods.description: Checks if the number has any units.

methods.name: hasUnit
methods.description: Checks if the number has exactly a specified unit.

methods.name: unitStr
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the number's units.

methods.name: valueInRange
methods.description: Checks and returns the number's value if within a specified range.

methods.name: valueInRangeWithUnit
methods.description: Checks and returns the number's value if within a specified range with units.

methods.name: assertNoUnits
methods.description: Throws exception if the number has units.

methods.name: assertUnit
methods.description: Throws exception if the number does not have a specific unit.

methods.name: assertSameUnitOrUnitless
methods.description: Ensures two numbers have compatible units or are unitless.

methods.name: coerce
methods.description: Returns a new Number coerced to specified units.

methods.name: isComparableTo
methods.description: Checks if this number is comparable to another, considering units.

methods.name: lessThan
methods.description: Checks if this number is less than another, with unit coercion.

methods.name: lessThanOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if this number is less than or equal to another, with unit coercion.

methods.name: greaterThan
methods.description: Checks if this number is greater than another, with unit coercion.

methods.name: greaterThanOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if this number is greater than or equal to another, with unit coercion.

methods.name: plus
methods.description: Adds another Number, returning a new Number.

methods.name: minus
methods.description: Subtracts another Number, returning a new Number.

methods.name: unaryMinus
methods.description: Negates the number.

methods.name: modulo
methods.description: Computes the modulus of this number with another.

methods.name: times
methods.description: Multiplies this number with another.

methods.name: dividedBy
methods.description: Divides this number by another.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if this number equals another, accounting for units.
